visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a brown tabby cat with narrowed, green-yellow eyes looking directly into the camera. A human hand enters from the left side of the frame, rhythmically patting the cat's lower back area. The cat's head is resting comfortably on a white windowsill. The background features a bright, sunlit window showing a clear blue sky with soft white clouds. Large white text overlays appear in the center of the screen. (2) The cat's facial expression changes as its eyes open wider, showing alertness but also contentment. The hand continues the steady, rhythmic patting motion on the cat's rear, causing the cat's fur to shift visibly with each movement. The cat's mouth is slightly open, revealing a small pink tongue and whiskers. The white captions at the center of the frame change to reflect the cat's internal state. (3) The camera focuses even tighter on the cat's face. The human hand moves from the cat's back to pet and stroke the top of its head and under its chin. The cat squint its eyes in bliss and leans its head upward into the touch. The lighting remains bright and natural, coming from the window. (4) The cat lowers its head back onto the white ledge, appearing very relaxed. The hand returns to the rhythmic patting of the cat's rear. The cat's eyes are mostly closed again, and its ears twitch slightly in response to the tactile stimulation. The outdoor scenery through the window provides a depth of field to the indoor setting. (5) The live video footage cuts to a static graphic end screen with a solid pink background. In the center, white text displays the brand logo '好味小姐' and the English text 'LADY FLAVOR'. The composition is simple and clean, marking the conclusion of the video clip.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A rhythmic, percussive thumping sound begins immediately, signifying manual patting on a soft surface. Simultaneously, a bright and playful acoustic guitar melody with a steady beat enters. A female voice speaks in a high-pitched, affectionate tone, mimicking cat-like vocalizations and talking to the pet. (2) The rhythmic patting sounds continue consistently at roughly 100 BPM, synchronized with the music. The female voice makes various supportive sounds like 'mmm' and 'hǎo yàn,' indicating positive feedback. The background music remains cheery and light. There are occasional soft meowing sounds from the cat under the speech. (3) The audio texture remains dense with the percussive thumping and the melodic background music. The female voice maintains its high pitch and friendly tone, sounding very relaxed and joyful. The clarity of the recording is high, with no distracting ambient noises from the environment. (4) Rhythmic patting continues as the primary acoustic event alongside the BGM. The speaker continues her commentary in an affectionate manner. The cat's purring is audible during the brief pauses between the speaker's phrases, adding a layer of naturalistic foley to the produced track. (5) The music and thumping sounds come to a sharp, synchronized stop. A very short, clean silence follows for less than a second before the audio track ends. The final transition is a hard cut, matching the visual transition to the brand logo screen.
